paper_title: Counterfactual Influence as a Distributional Quantity

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the variation in BLEU scores over a training period measured in epochs, for three different datasets or categories. The x-axis is labeled "Epochs" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 3 with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. The y-axis is labeled "BLEU score" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.00 to 0.35 with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The first line, representing "Regular members", is depicted in blue with a solid line and no markers, starting just below 0.05 at epoch 0.2 and fluctuating slightly around 0.05 throughout the epochs, ending slightly above 0.07 at epoch 3. The second line, denoting "Members with near-duplicates", is shown in orange with a solid line and no markers. It begins slightly under 0.05 at epoch 0.2 and exhibits a steep increase, reaching approximately 0.36 by epoch 3, with a noticeable acceleration occurring between epochs 1 and 2. The third line, indicating "Held-out data", is illustrated in green with a solid line and no markers. It begins just below 0.05 at epoch 0.2 and remains relatively steady throughout the epochs with slight fluctuations, ending around 0.03 at epoch 3. A legend is given center of the plot.
